perspective:
Jose Castillo has access to the following information:

- He works with Patricia Ndiaye at a community bank, where he occasionally helps with maintenance and repairs of bank equipment.
- He has a friendly but professional relationship with Patricia, and they sometimes talk about everyday work experiences.
- He noticed that Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual and remembered her as normally being vibrant.
- He asked if she was okay, and she said it was “nothing really,” just “personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated it.
- He overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- During a conversation, Patricia told him she had been feeling overwhelmed with her bills lately.
- He mentioned he had been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss budgeting tips with her.
- Patricia said that could be helpful and that she would take him up on the offer soon.
- He later worried that he might have overstepped by bringing up financial planning.
- He asked Patricia if she minded, and she told him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend.
- Patricia said she appreciated that and felt she had someone to turn to.
- Later, he asked about her weekend plans, and she said she was planning a quiet weekend at home.
- He offered again to be there if she needed anything or wanted to chat.
- Patricia thanked him and said she would keep it in mind.
- He continued checking in with Patricia at work, and she said she was busy but handling things and thanked him for checking in.
- He offered to help her with anything, even just grabbing a coffee, and Patricia said his support meant a lot.
